intent: Source-graded CLOS slot-state and class-metaobject historical proposals; not SENS program text, not accepted function identities
authority: D2 exclusively controls language structure/evaluation; D1 values are reused, not duplicated

rows.source_era: ANSI Common Lisp / CLOS (1994 HyperSpec tradition)
rows.observable_law: Return D1 yes iff object has a slot of this exact name, regardless of whether its value is unbound.
rows.positive_witness: Object C defines slot a without initform: exists(C,a)=YES, exists(C,z)=NO.
rows.falsifier: Defined-but-unbound a must NOT be treated as absent; stored NIL also counts as existing.
rows.ownership_question: Is structural slot existence already derivable from immutable class layout?

rows.source_era: ANSI Common Lisp / CLOS (1994 HyperSpec tradition)
rows.observable_law: Return D1 yes iff named existing slot has a bound value, including an explicit NIL value; unbound is distinct from nonexistence.
rows.positive_witness: Slot a declared without initform -> NO; assign a=NIL -> YES; slot still exists in both cases.
rows.falsifier: Must distinguish unbound slot from a bound NIL, and missing slot routes SLOT-MISSING rather than pretending false.
rows.ownership_question: Does existing D10 SLOT-VALUE expose boundness without triggering an error or default handler?

rows.source_era: ANSI Common Lisp / CLOS (1994 HyperSpec tradition)
rows.observable_law: Reset an existing instance slot to an unbound state without deleting the slot, changing class or clearing unrelated slots.
rows.positive_witness: C with a=3, b=4: SLOT-MAKUNBOUND(C,a) returns C; exists(a)=YES; boundp(a)=NO; value(b)=4.
rows.falsifier: Setting a=NIL is not unbinding; deleting the slot or mutating b is not equivalent.
rows.conceptual_neighbors: D10 SLOT-VALUE, CHANGE-CLASS proposal; D9 immutable vectors
rows.ownership_question: Requires explicit mutable-instance effect law; D2 retains evaluation/control authority.

rows.source_era: ANSI Common Lisp / CLOS (1994 HyperSpec tradition)
rows.observable_law: When an accessor targets a slot absent from a standard-class object, dispatch to the operation-aware method with class, object, name and operation; on read, primary returned value is observed.
rows.positive_witness: Custom SLOT-MISSING for SLOT-VALUE(C,z) returns sentinel, while existing-but-unbound a must follow SLOT-UNBOUND instead.
rows.falsifier: Do not conflate missing slot with unbound, and do not use hook return as result of SETF/MAKUNBOUND.
rows.conceptual_neighbors: D10 SLOT-VALUE, DEFGENERIC; #4842 CLOS method review
rows.ownership_question: Can this dispatch be a library-level data protocol rather than novel language control?

rows.source_era: ANSI Common Lisp / CLOS (1994 HyperSpec tradition)
rows.observable_law: On read of existing-but-unbound slot in a standard-class instance, dispatch to distinct hook; default signals UNBOUND-SLOT; primary handler value is used if provided.
rows.positive_witness: C has declared unbound a; SLOT-VALUE(C,a) follows SLOT-UNBOUND; SLOT-VALUE(C,z) follows SLOT-MISSING.
rows.falsifier: Never route a nonexisting slot to SLOT-UNBOUND; reading unbound cannot silently return NIL.
rows.ownership_question: Error/handler dispatch may belong to the D2-owned control-and-effects protocol.

rows.source_era: ANSI Common Lisp / CLOS (1994 HyperSpec tradition)
rows.observable_law: Return the exact class metaobject of which an object is a direct instance, not merely an approximate type specifier.
rows.positive_witness: After DEFCLASS Book and MAKE-INSTANCE, CLASS-OF(instance) is the Book class metaobject.
rows.falsifier: Returning only the symbol Book or any superclass rather than the direct class object violates the law.
rows.ownership_question: Class-object identity vs D10 TYPE-OF type-specifier should be proved observationally.

rows.source_era: ANSI Common Lisp / CLOS (1994 HyperSpec tradition)
rows.observable_law: Return the class name symbol if present; anonymous classes have NIL and name is not identical to class-object identity.
rows.positive_witness: Named class C has CLASS-NAME(C)=name; anonymous class has no proper name.
rows.falsifier: Never synthesize a proper name for an anonymous class or conflate class name with class identity.
rows.ownership_question: May be a direct projection from class descriptor and not merit a D10 slot.

rows.source_era: ANSI Common Lisp / CLOS (1994 HyperSpec tradition)
rows.observable_law: Resolve a symbol to a class metaobject in the explicitly applicable environment; missing with errorp false returns NIL, with default true signals error.
rows.positive_witness: FIND-CLASS(Book,false,env) returns same class as CLASS-OF(book); missing(false)=NIL.
rows.falsifier: Different environment binding must not silently alias class with same printed name; errorp true cannot silently return NIL.
rows.conceptual_neighbors: D10 DEFCLASS, TYPEP; D2 lexical environment
rows.ownership_question: Environment resolution/control is D2-owned, so a D10 class-lookup operation cannot mint independent control.
